# The trolley under the bridge: a red box 0.4 m with a yellow lid, origin at its bottom middle. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Body --base-color 1.0000 0.2510 0.2510 --no-slot
material new Top --base-color 1.0000 0.9255 0.4275 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Body --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.000 0.110
scale 0.400 0.400 0.220
apply --scale
material assign Body
add mesh cube --name Lid --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.000 0.250
scale 0.320 0.320 0.060
apply --scale
material assign Top
select all
shade flat
export trolley.glb
